mode: compile_only — no implementation authorized by this artifact; these shapes are a target a later implementation packet generates and validates against, not runtime code
doctrine: Voice is a thin adapter into the Cockpit Chat intent rail. Every type below binds to an EXISTING seam (chatStore.sendMessage source='voice', /advisor/converse routing + voice_turn_id, substrate/workstation/voice_route_resolver.VoiceRoute, cockpit voiceStore state machine, substrate/workstation/device_presence.DeviceSession). No type invents a parallel voice execution path.

grounding.wire_entry: cockpit/src/renderer/stores/chatStore.ts::sendMessage(content, source='voice', viewContext, voiceTurnId) -> POST /advisor/converse {content, source, routing, voice_turn_id}
grounding.transcript_source: umh/voice_server.py ws://:8096/voice emits {type:'transcript', text, final} — transcript-only, no intelligence
grounding.proof_chain: substrate/execution/intent/loop.py::submit -> AWAITING_APPROVAL -> governed approve -> PROOF_RECORDED with decided_by (P4S-31C proven, PR-era #217)

types.name: TranscriptEvent
types.purpose: One speech-to-text result emitted by the voice capture adapter before it enters Chat. Carries text + provenance; NEVER carries audio bytes and NEVER carries an execution decision.
types.binds_to: umh/voice_server.py transcript frame + chatStore addVoiceTranscript(text, voiceTurnId)

fields.name: text
fields.note: verbatim transcript; enters Chat unmodified as message content

fields.name: final
fields.note: final vs partial; only final transcripts submit to the intent rail (partials update draft only)

fields.name: confidence
fields.note: 0.0-1.0 STT confidence

fields.name: language
fields.note: BCP-47 tag, e.g. en-US; from STT or session locale

fields.name: voice_turn_id
fields.note: format vt-<uuid>; correlation id across capture->transcript->chat->loop; matches chatStore voice_turn_id on the wire

fields.name: started_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC; capture start

fields.name: emitted_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC; transcript emit

fields.name: source_device_id
fields.note: opaque dev-<ts>-<rand>; NOT a hostname; from deviceSessionStore

fields.name: source_session_id
fields.note: opaque sess-<ts>-<rand>; browser-tab scoped

fields.name: control_surface
fields.note: which cockpit surface captured it

fields.name: stt_engine
fields.note: which STT produced it, e.g. whisper_groq | faster_whisper | on_device; provenance only

fields.name: carries_audio
fields.note: INVARIANT: always false — TranscriptEvent never carries raw audio

types.name: WakeEvent
types.purpose: A wake-word detection signal. Opens a capture window ONLY if VoiceSession consent-state permits. Carries the detected keyword and confidence; NEVER carries audio.
types.binds_to: cockpit voiceStore activationMode {'wake_word'} + consent gate (target: on-device wake runtime)

fields.name: keyword
fields.note: the detected wake phrase (instance-configured, not a literal in substrate)

fields.name: confidence
fields.note: 0.0-1.0 detector confidence; below threshold is discarded

fields.name: detected_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: source_device_id
fields.note: opaque device id where detection ran (on-device only)

fields.name: consent_ref
fields.note: id of the VoiceConsentGrant that authorizes wake-word listening on this device+mode; absent/revoked => event rejected fail-closed

fields.name: wake_runtime
fields.note: which on-device detector fired, e.g. openwakeword | porcupine | platform_native; provenance

fields.name: carries_audio
fields.note: INVARIANT: always false — wake detection reports a keyword event, never audio

types.name: VoiceSession
types.purpose: The lifecycle of one operator voice interaction on one surface. Binds tenant identity (Clerk principal — the SAME principal that stamps decided_by in the proof) and gates capture behind explicit consent.
types.binds_to: substrate/workstation/device_presence.DeviceSession + cockpit voiceStore micState machine + Clerk operator principal (P4S-31C decided_by)

fields.name: voice_session_id
fields.note: opaque id for this voice interaction

fields.name: device_session_id
fields.note: maps to DeviceSession.session_id in the presence registry

fields.name: operator_principal
fields.note: Clerk principal, format clerk:user_<id>; the identity that will stamp decided_by; NEVER a hardcoded literal

fields.name: state
fields.note: explicit lifecycle; mirrors voiceStore micState transitions

fields.name: activation_mode
fields.note: always_on and wake_word REQUIRE an active VoiceConsentGrant for this device+mode

fields.name: consent_ref
fields.note: id of the VoiceConsentGrant covering this session; capture is refused fail-closed without it

fields.name: device_capability_ref
fields.note: id/role reference into DeviceCapabilityProfile (via infra/device_registry.json role), never a device name literal

fields.name: can_capture_audio
fields.note: from DeviceSession.can_capture_audio; false => session cannot enter capturing

fields.name: opened_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: closed_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC; set on close/deny/revoke

types.name: DeviceCapabilityProfile
types.purpose: Per-device voice capability descriptor, keyed by device ROLE/id from infra/device_registry.json — never by hardcoded device name. Declares what voice modes a device may offer.

fields.name: device_registry_id
fields.note: id key from infra/device_registry.json (resolved at runtime); the ONLY device binding — no hostnames as truth

fields.name: device_role
fields.note: orchestrator role MUST have has_microphone=false (no mic on the VPS, hard rule)

fields.name: has_microphone
fields.note: false for orchestrator role always

fields.name: can_play_audio
fields.note: TTS output capability

fields.name: push_to_talk
fields.note: supports explicit press-to-capture

fields.name: wake_word_runtime
fields.note: 'none' => wake mode not offered on this device

fields.name: on_device_stt
fields.note: whether transcription can run locally (privacy-preferred)

fields.name: ambient_capable
fields.note: always_on feasibility for this device; false unless platform feasibility is PROVEN in the matrix

fields.name: capture_api
fields.note: the platform capture surface, e.g. web_getUserMedia | native_AVAudioEngine | native_AudioRecord; from feasibility matrix

types.name: PlatformVoiceAdapter
types.purpose: The ONE adapter contract every platform target implements. It captures audio locally, produces TranscriptEvents, and hands them to Chat via the existing sendMessage source='voice' seam. It NEVER classifies intent, NEVER dispatches work, NEVER calls a provider.
types.binds_to: chatStore.addVoiceTranscript / sendMessage(source='voice'); umh/voice_server.py ws protocol as the reference desktop-browser adapter

members.name: requestConsent(device_registry_id, activation_mode) -> VoiceConsentGrant
members.note: must resolve before any capture; fail-closed

members.name: openSession(consent_ref) -> VoiceSession
members.note: transitions consent_granted -> mic_opening -> capturing; refuses if can_capture_audio=false

members.name: startCapture() -> void
members.note: push_to_talk: on press; wake_word/always_on: on WakeEvent under consent

members.name: onWake(WakeEvent)
members.note: only wired when activation_mode in {wake_word, always_on}

members.name: fail_closed
members.note: missing consent, mic denied, STT down, or WS unavailable => refuse with typed error, never degrade to an ungoverned path

members.name: typed_outcomes
members.note: mirror voiceStore VoiceOutcome enum: MIC_PERMISSION_DENIED | MIC_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE | VOICE_WS_UNAVAILABLE | STT_FAILED | NO_SPEECH_DETECTED | TIMEOUT | RECORDING_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED

fields.name: invariants
items: adapter output is ALWAYS a chat message via source='voice' — never a direct call to classify_intent, intent_loop_submit, or governed_mutation
adapter attaches voice_turn_id + routing but stamps NO identity — the operator Clerk principal is resolved server-side at /advisor/converse

types.name: VoiceConsentGrant
types.purpose: Stored, revocable record that an operator authorized voice capture on a specific device in a specific mode. Ambient (always_on) and wake_word capture is IMPOSSIBLE without an active grant. This is the hard constraint against always-on mic.
types.binds_to: new stored state (implementation packet); referenced by VoiceSession.consent_ref and WakeEvent.consent_ref

fields.name: operator_principal
fields.note: Clerk principal who granted; format clerk:user_<id>

fields.name: device_registry_id
fields.note: device the grant covers; from infra/device_registry.json

fields.name: activation_mode
fields.note: consent is PER-MODE: a push_to_talk grant does NOT authorize always_on

fields.name: granted_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.note: ISO-8601 UTC; presence => grant inactive; capture refused

fields.name: active
fields.note: derived: granted and not revoked; false => all capture in this mode refused fail-closed

cross_type_invariants: voice_turn_id threads TranscriptEvent -> chat message -> intent loop; it is the correlation key proving the spoken word and the governed proof are the same turn
operator_principal appears on VoiceSession and VoiceConsentGrant and MUST equal the Clerk principal that stamps decided_by in the resulting proof (identity is not re-minted by voice)

no type carries audio bytes except the transient capture buffer inside PlatformVoiceAdapter, which is never persisted and never leaves the device by default (cloud-transcription is DEFERRED to privacy review)
